name: roll neck rotation lying on floor
description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the neck. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under the base of your skull.
Place the roller under the neck and let your body weight settle onto it.
Gently turn your head slowly from side to side.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
